title: Prove sharp BIT bounds for same-chart helper specialization
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

An injective restriction and determinant matching prove maximum signed gain zero for arbitrary-codimension same-chart specialization followed by deletion of newly zero packets. A separate intersection theorem gives the same upper when one arbitrary local relation may remove dependent packets while preserving each historical stock span. A noncoordinate 679-owner literal matches both orientations and trades one grade-four paid occurrence for one grade-four productive relation.

## Task and overlap

This is a refined follow-up to [#7852](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7852) at `41beda1d6435760dc99e38bd7e65f36798aad212`, on main `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`. Native baseline and prior coordinate closure [#7830](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7830) at `87fbf4f7b35b0f18ab12b5767775a9a424cf0b15`, [#7974](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7974) at `a9473218bcbc2bb79b5745d8c72f310be14c2d8c`. Conditional finite application and its arithmetic gates [#7863](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7863) at `b3e4412fe01f07dc58305616fabf96345f49a781`, [#7975](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7975) at `46368d288e9dfad1cffce2af5094cbedfe84cb06`. The new proof covers arbitrary cochart linear combinations under its stated codec and ownership scopes.

## Validation

In a clean Python 3.12 extraction run `sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS` and `python3 -I -B verify.py`. Independent primitive replay recounts the 430 and 552 eligible pulse rows, the 679-owner control, full 36/48-call bins and damaged ADD and retirement controls.

## Open next questions

Change surviving packet values or jointly rebuild input and output interfaces, then rebind all costs and physical finite premises.
